file: How To Overcome Any Sales Objections - Best Sales Objection Handling Techniques
brief: A sales objection is simply a reason for why somebody doesn't  want to purchase your product and service. It's your job as a seller to uncover the truth behind why they're not buying and  remove that blocker and help them make a purchasing decision. No matter what it is that you're selling, whether you're in sales, business development,  or if you're an entrepreneur, sales objections are going to come from anything that  wasn't discussed in the actual sales meeting. It's your job to  remove this obstacle so they can walk from point A to point B.
